params.name: in_optimisation
params.label: Input optimisation set:
params.help: Input optimisation set. This will be passed with a --i argument to the executable. If any individual components of the optimisation set are specified below, then they will override the components in this optimisation set.

params.name: use_direct_entries
params.label: OR: use direct entries?
params.help: If set to Yes, the optimisation set will be ignored and the direct entries below will be used instead.

params.name: in_tomograms
params.label: Input tomogram set:
params.help: Input tomogram set STAR file. This file gets generated during Tomogram Reconstruction, and updated during Tomogram Frame Alignment or Tomogram CTF Refinement.

params.name: in_trajectories
params.label: Input trajectory set:
params.help: Input trajectory set. Leave empty if no particle motion tracks have been estimated during tomogram frame alignment.

params.name: box_size_angst
params.label: Box size (A):
params.help: The final particle box size in Angstrom.

params.name: precrop_size_angst
params.label: Pre-cropping box size (A):
params.help: If set to a positive value, then a larger box size can be used to extract 2D slices out of the micrograph, pre-multiply these with the CTF, and then crop to the box size above. A sufficiently large pre-crop box size therefore will allow more of the high-frequency signal to be captured that has been delocalised by the CTF.

params.name: binned_size_pix
params.label: Binning to box size (pixels):
params.help: The box size above will be binned to yield the number of pixels given here. Smaller boxes will refine faster and occupy less space, but will be limited to lower Nyquist frequency.

params.name: max_dose
params.label: Maximum dose (e/A^2):
params.help: Tilt series frames with a dose higher than this maximum dose (in electrons per squared Angstroms) will not be included in the 3D pseudo-subtomogram, or in the 2D stack. For the latter, this will disc I/O operations and increase speed.

params.name: min_frames
params.label: Minimum nr. frames:
params.help: Each selected pseudo-subtomogram need to be visible in at least this number of tilt series frames with doses below the maximum dose

params.name: subtomo_format
params.label: Subtomogram format:
params.help: Format of the extracted subtomograms. Relion-5 type 2D stacks, relion-4 type 3D pseudo-subtomograms, or relion-3 type real-space subtomograms. Some people have reported that real-space 3D subtomograms are better for initial alignments than 2D stacks or 3D pseudo-subtomograms. You may want to use AreTomo2 reconstructions for extracting real-space subtomograms. They can be made as part of the Align tilt-series job.

params.name: do_float16
params.label: Write output in float16?
params.help: If set to Yes, this program will write output images in float16 MRC format. This will save a factor of two in disk space compared to the default of writing in float32. Note that RELION and CCPEM will read float16 images, but other programs may not (yet) do so.

params.name: nr_mpi
params.label: Number of MPI procs:
params.help: Number of MPI nodes to use in parallel. When set to 1, MPI will not be used.

params.name: nr_threads
params.label: Number of threads:
params.help: Number of shared-memory (POSIX) threads to use in parallel. When set to 1, no multi-threading will be used.

params.name: other_args
params.label: Additional arguments:
params.help: In this box command-line arguments may be provided that are not generated by the GUI.
